Learned more about the specifics of responsibilities between the model, view, and controller and what type of functions or components are where and why. Did some drills to practice and make sure I know the responsibility of each. Learned a little bit about conventions of naming folders of MVC apps (like naming the model "services"). Learned that the "service" or model folder is for communication, and controller is for UI coordination.
